title: Subagent output contract
description: Result a child agent returns to its parent. Required fields are only those the parent reads to decide the next step. A schema pass does not verify that evidence or artifacts are true; the parent checks those separately.

status.description: Overall outcome. completed: acceptance criteria met. partial: some done, rest in unresolved. blocked: cannot proceed, reason in unresolved.

end.description: Optional termination reason, matching the End field of the task contract.

result.description: Short summary of the key result.

evidence.description: What was verified and where. Empty only when nothing could be verified; then status must not be completed.

artifacts.description: Paths of files created or changed.

checks.description: Checks or test commands that were run, with their outcome.

unresolved.description: Open questions, blockers, and the minimum information needed to continue. Must be non-empty when status is partial or blocked.

scope_changes.description: Deviations from the assigned read/write scope, if any.
